newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN SHARES SLIDE AFTER BOURSE, WARY BEFORE U.S.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN SHARES SLIDE AFTER BOURSE, WARY BEFORE U.S.

text.p: 1206 GMT - German shares extend day's losses in after-bourse electronic trade, sliding sharply after support levels break. Traders say fears abound that crucial U.S. data will indicate inflationary pressure, more losses expected on Wall Street. Data due at 1230 GMT.
* 30-share IBIS DAX down 138.62 points at 4,238.89 points, sharply down from mid-afternoon bourse close, when DAX ended at 4,278.48 points. Support broke around 4,270, dealers say.
* September DTB DAX futures down 131 at 4,257.0.
* Losses spread across the board, Hoechst lower despite releasing H1 results in line with expectations.
